module: Flowgraph node "Set Camera Position" (repeat_instant). Moves the free camera to a position, entered in the node ('custom' mode) or supplied by a vec3 pin 'pos' ('from Pin' mode, dynamically created pin). The camera's current rotation is kept. The output pin value (vec3) returns the applied position.
notes: The 'value' pin is declared with direction 'out' (vec3) whereas the description says "position to set camera to": it is indeed an output that reflects the applied position.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by _flowgraph_createNode(C)). The methods are called by the flowgraph manager or the editor.

init.desc: Initializes the position to (0,0,0), the mode to 'custom' and the mode list {'custom','from Pin'}.

drawCustomProperties.desc: Editor properties panel: mode choice, x/y/z fields, buttons "Set from camera" and "Preview". Creates or deletes the 'pos' pin depending on the mode. Returns a reason string if a change occurred.

work.desc: Switches to the free camera if needed, reads the position from the 'pos' pin in 'from Pin' mode, applies the position (SetCamera) and writes the value pin.

drawMiddle.desc: Central area of the node in the editor (nothing displayed).

SetCamera.desc: Calls core_camera.setPosRot(0, ...) with the node's position and the camera's current rotation (core_camera.getQuat).

_onSerialize.desc: Saves the position (res.ppos) and the mode (res.mode).

_onDeserialized.desc: Restores position and mode; recreates the 'pos' pin in 'from Pin' mode.
